title: Lazy River

services.name: Day Passes
services.desc: Looking for a fun-filled day out without committing to an overnight stay? Lazy River Campground At Granville has you covered with our unique day pass option. As one of the few campgrounds in Ohio offering this flexibility, we're excited to welcome you to a world of outdoor excitement. Whether you're planning a family outing, a corporate event, or just looking for a day of fun, our featured passes are your ticket to adventure. Get in touch with us to learn more about how you can make the most of your day at Lazy River Campground. Please note our Zipline, Challenge Course, and Laser Tag run at scheduled times and are not always available. Contact our friendly Reception team for details prior

explain.meaning: Entry for one day, coming and going as you like.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Nestled in the scenic landscapes of Granville, Ohio, Lazy River Campground offers a year-round outdoor escape for adventure seekers and nature lovers alike. As a family-owned and operated haven, we've been providing memorable camping experiences for over two decades.
